headline: Defense Stocks Fall on Expectations of Tighter US Pentagon Budgets
summary: Defense sector equities declined following Democratic electoral victories that stoked investor concerns over potential tightening of future Pentagon budgets.
why: Defense contractors rely heavily on government defense spending authorizations. Shifts in congressional control can alter military procurement priorities and future revenue pipelines.

impacts.name: Aerospace & Defense
impacts.why: Fears of tighter Pentagon budgets following Democratic victories weighed on defense equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors sold defense shares due to concerns that a Democratic-led Congress would constrain future military spending.
